title: 2013 真题 Text 2 · 新时代的候鸟移民
description: 探讨往返于不同国家的流动移民与僵化的移民分类制度。
author: 2013 English Exam
heroNote: birds of passage 是全文核心比喻，注意 legal or illegal 的二分框架与作者的主张。

sentences.en: A century ago, the immigrants from across the Atlantic included settlers and sojourners.
sentences.zhReference: 一个世纪前，横渡大西洋而来的移民中既有定居者，也有短暂停留的人。

sentences.en: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
sentences.zhReference: 除了许多希望在美国永久安家的人，还有一些人无意久留，只想挣些钱就回家。

sentences.en: Between 1908 and 1915, about 7 million people arrived while about 2 million departed.
sentences.zhReference: 1908 年至 1915 年间，约有七百万人抵达美国，同时约有两百万人离开。

sentences.en: About a quarter of all Italian immigrants, for example, eventually returned to Italy for good.
sentences.zhReference: 例如，大约四分之一的意大利移民最终永久返回了意大利。

sentences.en: They even had an affectionate nickname, uccelli di passaggio, birds of passage.
sentences.zhReference: 他们甚至有一个亲切的绰号：uccelli di passaggio，即候鸟般来去的人。

sentences.en: Today, we are much more rigid about immigrants.
sentences.zhReference: 如今，我们看待移民的方式要僵化得多。

sentences.en: We divide newcomers into two categories: legal or illegal, good or bad.
sentences.zhReference: 我们把新来者分成两类：合法或非法，好人或坏人。

sentences.en: We hail them as Americans in the making, or brand them as aliens to be kicked out.
sentences.zhReference: 我们要么称赞他们是未来的美国人，要么给他们贴上应被驱逐的外国人标签。

sentences.en: That framework has contributed mightily to our broken immigration system and the long political paralysis over how to fix it.
sentences.zhReference: 这种思维框架在很大程度上造成了移民制度的失灵，也导致了如何修复这一制度的长期政治僵局。

sentences.en: We don't need more categories, but we need to change the way we think about categories.
sentences.zhReference: 我们不需要更多类别，但需要改变思考这些类别的方式。

sentences.en: We need to look beyond strict definitions of legal and illegal.
sentences.zhReference: 我们需要超越合法与非法的严格界限。

sentences.en: To start, we can recognize the new birds of passage, those living and thriving in the gray areas.
sentences.zhReference: 首先，我们可以承认新时代候鸟移民的存在：他们在灰色地带生活并发展。

sentences.en: We might then begin to solve our immigration challenges.
sentences.zhReference: 这样，我们或许才能开始解决移民问题。

sentences.en: Crop pickers, violinists, construction workers, entrepreneurs, engineers, home health-care aides and physicists are among today's birds of passage.
sentences.zhReference: 如今的候鸟移民包括采摘工、小提琴家、建筑工人、企业家、工程师、居家护理助理和物理学家。

sentences.en: They are energetic participants in a global economy driven by the flow of work, money and ideas.
sentences.zhReference: 他们是全球经济中充满活力的参与者；这一经济由工作、资金和思想的流动所驱动。

sentences.en: They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them.
sentences.zhReference: 他们更愿意随机会的召唤自由往来。

sentences.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
sentences.zhReference: 他们可以在一个地方工作，同时让家人生活在另一个地方。

sentences.en: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
sentences.zhReference: 不管有没有许可，他们都能自如地跨越不同的法律、司法管辖区和身份界限。

sentences.en: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
sentences.zhReference: 我们应让他们相信，美国可以是一个让他们暂时发挥所长、而无需承诺永久定居的地方。

sentences.en: We need them to feel that home can be both here and there and that they can belong to two nations honorably.
sentences.zhReference: 我们要让他们觉得这里和那里都可以是家，也可以体面地归属于两个国家。

sentences.en: Accommodating this new world of people in motion will require new attitudes on both sides of the immigration battle.
sentences.zhReference: 要适应这个人口不断流动的新世界，移民争论的双方都需要转变态度。

sentences.en: Looking beyond the culture war logic of right or wrong means opening up the middle ground and understanding that managing immigration today requires multiple paths and multiple outcomes, including some that are not easy to accomplish legally in the existing system.
sentences.zhReference: 超越文化战争中非对即错的逻辑，意味着开辟中间地带，并认识到当今移民管理需要多种路径和结果；其中一些在现有制度下很难通过合法途径实现。
